#!/bin/sh
# RVC Stage A v5 — rebuilt for the RESTRUCTURED upstream repo (2026-10-25).
# v4 died at FAIL_DEPS: upstream deleted requirements.txt; deps now live in
# requirments_cpu_py312.txt (their spelling) which pins torch 2.4.1+cpu itself.
# New module paths: train/preprocess.py, train/dataset/extract_f0.py,
# train/dataset/extract_hubert_feature.py. Stage A ends by tarballing the exp
# dir and uploading it to Gofile so Stage B (fresh runner) can continue.
export TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD=1
ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
REF="$ROOT/cloud-pc/storage/naruto-ref.flac"
[ -f "$REF" ] || REF="$ROOT/cloud-pc/storage/voices/naruto-ref.flac"
echo "REF=$REF"; ls -la "$REF" || { echo FAIL_REF; exit 1; }
cd $HOME && rm -rf rvc && git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/RVC-Project/Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI.git rvc || { echo FAIL_CLONE; exit 1; }
cd $HOME/rvc && echo CLONE_OK && ls
# ffmpeg binary via imageio-ffmpeg (runner has none)
pip install -q imageio-ffmpeg || { echo FAIL_FFMPEG_PIP; exit 1; }
FF=$(python3 -c "import imageio_ffmpeg; print(imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe())")
mkdir -p /tmp/ffbin && ln -sf "$FF" /tmp/ffbin/ffmpeg && export PATH=/tmp/ffbin:$PATH
ffmpeg -version | head -1 || { echo FAIL_FFMPEG; exit 1; }
# deps: the repo's own CPU/py312 requirements (pins torch 2.4.1+cpu).
# Fallback: swap the CN mirrors for pypi.org + pytorch.org if the first pass fails.
pip install -q -r requirments_cpu_py312.txt || { echo RETRY_DEPS_WITH_PYPI; sed -i 's|https://mirrors.pku.edu.cn/pypi/simple|https://pypi.org/simple|; s|https://mirrors.nju.edu.cn/pytorch/whl/cpu|https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu|' requirments_cpu_py312.txt; pip install -q -r requirments_cpu_py312.txt; } || { echo FAIL_DEPS; exit 1; }
python3 -c "import torch; print('TORCH', torch.__version__)" || { echo FAIL_TORCH; exit 1; }
echo INSTALL_OK
# base models: hubert + rmvpe + v2 pretrained pair (for stage B seeding)
mkdir -p assets/hubert assets/rmvpe assets/pretrained_v2
curl -sL -o assets/hubert/hubert_base.pt https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI/resolve/main/hubert_base.pt
curl -sL -o assets/rmvpe/rmvpe.pt https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI/resolve/main/rmvpe.pt
curl -sL -o assets/pretrained_v2/f0G40k.pth https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI/resolve/main/pretrained_v2/f0G40k.pth
curl -sL -o assets/pretrained_v2/f0D40k.pth https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI/resolve/main/pretrained_v2/f0D40k.pth
ls -la assets/hubert/hubert_base.pt assets/rmvpe/rmvpe.pt || { echo FAIL_MODELS; exit 1; }
echo MODELS_OK
# dataset: convert ref to wav, hand to RVC preprocess (it slices)
mkdir -p $HOME/dataset && ffmpeg -y -v error -i "$REF" -ar 44100 $HOME/dataset/naruto_ref.wav || { echo FAIL_CONVERT; exit 1; }
EXP=naruto-en
EXPDIR=$HOME/rvc/logs/$EXP
mkdir -p $EXPDIR
export PYTHONPATH=$HOME/rvc
python3 -P train/preprocess.py $HOME/dataset 40000 2 $EXPDIR False 3.0 2>&1 | tail -3
N_GT=$(find $EXPDIR -name '*.wav' | wc -l); echo "GT_WAVS=$N_GT"
[ "$N_GT" -gt 3 ] || { echo FAIL_PREPROCESS; find $EXPDIR | head -30; exit 1; }
echo PREPROCESS_OK
# F0 extraction (RMVPE) — new CLI: extract_f0.py cpu <exp_dir> <n_p> <f0method>
python3 -P train/dataset/extract_f0.py cpu $EXPDIR 2 rmvpe 2>&1 | tail -3
N_F0=$(find $EXPDIR -name '*.npy' | wc -l); echo "NPY_AFTER_F0=$N_F0"
[ "$N_F0" -gt 3 ] || { echo FAIL_F0; find $EXPDIR | head -40; exit 1; }
echo F0_OK
# HuBERT features — new CLI: cpu <n_part> <i_part> <exp_dir> <version> <is_half>
python3 -P train/dataset/extract_hubert_feature.py cpu 1 0 $EXPDIR v2 false 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "--- EXP DIR MAP ---"
find $EXPDIR -maxdepth 2 -type d | sort
for d in $(find $EXPDIR -maxdepth 2 -type d | sort); do echo "$d : $(ls $d | wc -l) files"; done
N_ALL=$(find $EXPDIR -type f | wc -l); echo "EXP_FILES_TOTAL=$N_ALL"
[ "$N_ALL" -gt 30 ] || { echo FAIL_FEATURE; exit 1; }
echo FEATURE_OK
# persist for stage B: tar the exp dir, upload to Gofile, print the link
tar -czf $HOME/exp-$EXP.tar.gz -C $HOME/rvc/logs $EXP || { echo FAIL_TAR; exit 1; }
ls -la $HOME/exp-$EXP.tar.gz
UP=$(curl -s -F file=@$HOME/exp-$EXP.tar.gz https://upload.gofile.io/uploadfile)
echo "GOFILE_RESPONSE=$UP"
echo "$UP" | grep -q downloadPage || { echo FAIL_UPLOAD; exit 1; }
echo STAGE_A5_DONE
